ValidationRule.description: CRM-8711: Only CCAT user should have access to submit a case with case origin as "ACA Website" and Dispute type as "ACA Eligible" or "ACA Ineligible"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Origin , 'ACA Website'), OR( ISPICKVAL( QCC_Dispute_Type__c , 'ACA Eligible'), ISPICKVAL(QCC_Dispute_Type__c , 'ACA Ineligible') ) ), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Origin , 'ACA Website')), OR( ISPICKVAL(QCC_Dispute_Type__c , 'ACA Ineligible'), ISPICKVAL( QCC_Dispute_Type__c , 'ACA Eligible') ) ), AND( OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(QCC_Dispute_Type__c , 'ACA Ineligible')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( QCC_Dispute_Type__c , 'ACA Eligible')) ), ISPICKVAL(Origin , 'ACA Website') ) ), NOT($User.CCAT_User__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - Freight', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - QCC', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - SND', $Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator - Freight', $Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator - Global', $Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator - QCC', $Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator - SND' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only CCAT user should have access to submit a case with case origin as "ACA Website" and Dispute type as "ACA Eligible" or "ACA Ineligible"
